command:
set -euo pipefail
echo '=== SCRATCH CHROME LEAK INSPECTION READONLY ==='
date -Is; hostname
echo PRODUCTION_PID=$(pgrep -fo '/opt/google/chrome/chrome --app=http://127.0.0.1:8788/' || true)
echo '--- SCRATCH CHROME PROCESSES ---'
ps -eo pid,ppid,user,lstart,args --sort=pid | grep -E '[c]hrome.*(eye-scheduler|go-eye|remote-debugging-port=93[0-9][0-9])' || true
echo '--- ALL REMOTE DEBUG LISTENERS 9300-9399 ---'
ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | awk '$4 ~ /:93[0-9][0-9]$/ {print}' || true
echo '--- TEMP PROFILE DIRECTORIES ---'
find /tmp -maxdepth 2 -type d \( -name 'eye-scheduler-*' -o -name 'go-eye-*' \) -printf '%TY-%Tm-%TdT%TH:%TM:%TS %u:%g %p\n' 2>/dev/null | sort || true
echo '=== END READONLY ==='
